page.layout: One text column, left of centre, with running head above it. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the text of the second half of the column. Below the text, a catchword at right. At the foot, gathering signature marks, centre, and a digitiser's stamp at right edge (omitted).

main_text.p: fame perèundum foret, dicam etiam licitè bona defendi posse, cum internecione invasoris. Jam enim pari passu ambulabunt, vita & bona, quod hisce ademptis certa mors immi-neat.

Consentiunt legibus hacte-nus[?] allegatis etiam canones.C. fusce-pimus, c. fi perfo-diens. de Homicid. Quibus cautum, ne fures qui ad furandum veniunt occidan-tur, neve tam acriter exardes-camus, ut ad rerum transitoriarum conservationem proxic. Inter-fecisti. de Homicid.mum interficiamus. Neque obstat 1. Quod objicit Lesius ex jure canonico. Vbi dicitur. Si sine odii meditatione, te tuaque liberando, hujusmodi diaboli membra interfecisti: si aliquid jejunare volueris, bonum est tibi & eleemosynas fac largiter. Respondeo enim 1. in objecto canone duo requiruntur copulative, te tuaque defendendo, id est ut vis sit illata bonis, etiam corpori. Vt non

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are set beside the text and given in full in place; the mark at "proxi-mum" is an ink blot, not a letter. "hacte-nus" is uncertain: the long-s ligature is hard to read, so the word is marked [?]. "immi-neat" is kept as printed, with the line-end hyphen. The signature marks at the foot are faint and uncertain. The faint "...003" at the right edge is a digitiser's stamp and is left out.
